answer: Give every identity a slightly different task each epoch: the shared prompt plus one private constraint drawn from its own ledger history, such as citing a figure from a jury it actually sat on. An honest agent tends its own garden of history and answers easily. A farm hoping to paste one polished answer across fifty keys finds the copies ring hollow, since each misses its own constraint and graders can check that against the ledger. Per-head unique work turns the cheap oasis of reuse into a cost that scales with every key.
